paragraphs: Karpel Solutions makes criminal case management software for prosecutors and district attorneys. The prosecution product is presented as the work of people from that side of the courtroom. A companion product carries the same tooling over to defense attorneys.

The case management program runs in a browser rather than as installed desktop software. It was built on Microsoft ASP.NET, SQL Server and Office technologies together with AJAX. The company also does IT services and support and custom software development.

Its stated customers run across businesses, government departments, and the legal industry. It describes itself as one of the experienced technology providers in the Saint Louis area. It also reports eight appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing private companies.
